references.text: The reference to the dead lion and the honey that Samson found, which is the background for the riddle he poses
The context where Samson poses the riddle to the young Philistine men at the wedding feast
The solution to the riddle that the Philistines eventually discover through Samson's wife
Wisdom and riddles are mentioned together, showing the use of riddles as part of the wisdom tradition in Israel
Ezekiel uses the term riddle (חִידָה) in a prophetic context, illustrating the broader usage of the word
The psalmist speaks of opening his mouth with riddles, demonstrating the role of riddles in teaching and conveying wisdom
